name: sprite_builder_get_build
description: Get a build by id and check its status. Lifecycle: queued -> running -> succeeded | failed. On 'succeeded' the live URL is in `url`; `logs` holds build output and `error` is set on failure. Poll this after sprite_builder_create_build.

build_id.description: The build's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_build / sprite_builder_list_builds).
